notes:
Background: Afterword builds post-call QA and coaching for mid-size contact centers. Main product ingests call audio, generates transcript, QA scorecard, coaching highlights and suggested agent actions (tool calls into CRMs). They sell to verticals with PHI/PII needs (healthcare & finance) and direct customers insist audio cannot leave customer network.

Current state: evaluation stage — interested in Redwood Dedicated or Private. Done discovery + SLA/security intro. SE deep-dive completed 2026-03-04. They uploaded 48 sample calls (mixed English/Spanish) for model fit tests.

Technical requirements / priorities (verbatim & paraphrase):
- "We need summarization and QA notes within 20s post-call for supervisors to triage."
- Real-time mid-call assist desirable for complex escalations (target RTT <200ms token latency for assist pipeline).
- Throughput: baseline 10k calls/hour, peak 30k/hr during promos. Must sustain spikes without dropped requests.
- Routing/fallback: want policy to route to smaller cheaper model for short calls and fallback to higher-quality model when QA triggers.
- Data controls: VPC/private control plane, KMS integration, per-customer audit logs, configurable retention + redaction rules (PII masking).
- Integration: Genesys Cloud primary contact center; also must support Amazon Connect and webhooks to update tickets in Zendesk. Tool-calling patterns: create ticket, add tags, escalate.

POC plan & acceptance criteria (from call 2026-03-10):
- 7-day POC on Dedicated with simulated spike day (day 3).
- Deliverables: automated post-call summary pipeline, QA scorecards with configurable rubrics, coaching highlights extraction, tool-calling webhook to sandbox Zendesk.
- Perf targets: 95th percentile post-call summary <20s, sustained 99th percentile throughput during spike with <5% error rate.
- Security: SOC2 evidence + network design review; DR plan for on-prem option.

Recent conversations / notes (short bullets):
- 2026-03-04 SE deep-dive: discussed KV cache reuse for repeated caller context; Diego suggested batching by caller-session to reduce cost.
- 2026-03-06 Security questionnaire sent (drive link). Waiting for completed answers from security team.
- 2026-03-10 Exec sponsor call (ff-20260211-76a9). Sponsor: CTO Priya Menon. "Can't have audio leave our VPC for regulated accounts."
- 2026-03-10 Pricing ask: estimate for Dedicated 4xA100 equivalent with burst to 8x during promos. They asked for committed monthly vs burst pricing options.
- Uploaded artifacts: sample transcripts, QA rubrics, Genesys integration notes.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: on-prem/VPC requirement increases delivery time. Mitigation: propose Hybrid Private (control plane in Redwood, inference inside customer VPC) + security review sprint.
- Risk: cost/perf tradeoffs under load. Mitigation: Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) and can run a benchmark day in POC.

Quotes & tone: buyer pragmatic, engineering-led evaluation. Frequent shorthand in notes. Wants a firm SLA and transparent unit economics.

Next immediate actions:
- Send final POC scope + test plan (owner: Maya) by 2026-03-13.
- Schedule Genesys sandbox integration window for week of 2026-03-16 (owner: Diego).
- Security to reply to questionnaire by 2026-03-15 (owner: Elena).
